violated_contract: Every shadow rendezvous operation read all four slot documents in one Firestore transaction, so concurrent offer/take/reserve cycles shared one read set and Firestore aborted them all, surfacing as the two largest production error signatures (~1,800 log events/30min). Coordination writes that race on the same documents must not share a transaction read set: each server reads one slot at a time and claims it with a single conditional write the database arbitrates by document version; losers skip one cycle instead of aborting anybody.
canonical_prevention: Route shadow-slot offer/take/reserve through the point-read-plus-fenced-write lane in database/batch_pipeline_shadow.py (shadow_slot_cas_enabled default-on kill switch BATCH_PIPELINE_CONTENTION_RETRY_ENABLED), pinned by the fence-race double in tests/unit/fixtures/shadow_slot_cas_firestore.py and the CAS contract tests in tests/unit/test_batch_shadow_slot_cas.py.
